_comment: GOLDEN EVAL — es-ES. Every case is a real message from a SEEDED customer (seed/contacts.json) against the REAL catalogue (seed/catalogue.json: Cárnicas Aldonza, Mercamadrid), run through the REAL pipeline by tests/test_golden.py. Customer text is trade Spanish, elliptical, the way a message at 06:10 actually reads; the documentation around it is English because it is read next to test_golden.py. Seven intake buckets of three (reference · discourse · implicit · change · identity · grounding · voice) assert WHAT WAS UNDERSTOOD; the eighth bucket, `doubt`, asserts THE LAW (§5.7/§5.7a) — who gets asked, how many times, with how many options, and what must never be answered by the customer at all. Rewritten 2026-07-27: the previous fixture still expected the ENGLISH sku ids the seed replaced in 08a2d18bb, and nothing went red because this file needs a DB + an LLM and the harness therefore never runs it. `test_golden_fixture_is_grounded` in test_golden.py now checks the ids/phones/names with NO database and NO model, so the same rot fails loudly next time.

_expect_schema.lines: [{sku, qty?, unit?}] — the sku must be on the order. qty/unit asserted only where the message states them; an implicit/standing case asserts presence only.
_expect_schema.absent: [sku] — must NOT be on the order (a removal, or a standing basket that must not expand).
_expect_schema.no_clean: true — no line may be filled CLEAN (attention='clean' with a sku_id) for a sku outside `lines`. On a case with no expected lines this is the old out-of-assortment assertion; on a mixed order it is the stronger one: the real lines fill, the gap does not silently become a product.
_expect_schema.date: 'tomorrow' — delivery_date must be tomorrow's ISO date. Any other truthy value asserts a date was resolved at all.
_expect_schema.doubt: true — some line carries note/underline or a keep-in-mind. 'It was not filled silently.'
_expect_schema.doubt_kinds: [kind] — the doubt verdict must contain a line of EVERY listed kind (ambiguous · dimensionless · unit · thin · unknown · conflict). Read off `_doubt`, the verdict pipeline._compute rides out.
_expect_schema.ask_direction: 'customer' — a question went out AND every asked entry is customer-facing.
_expect_schema.not_asked: true — the customer was asked NOTHING this order.
_expect_schema.to_comercial: true — at least one doubted line is directed at the comercial (§5.8's park).
_expect_schema.max_questions: int — the question BUDGET (§5.7a: one per order). Three ambiguous lines must not become three questions.
_expect_schema.max_options: int — options per question (§5.7a: 2 candidates + «Ninguno, te digo» = Meta's 3 buttons). A mention that ties across five rows cannot get to two and is UNKNOWN, not a three-way choice.
_expect_schema.no_doubt: true — nothing doubted and nothing asked. Used to pin NEVER TWICE: a mention this customer already taught us must never come back as a question.

cases.text: buenas, ponme lo mismo que el jueves pasado
cases.probes: standing order by reference to a past delivery day — the four lines must come back off the history, unprompted

cases.text: repíteme el último pedido
cases.probes: explicit repeat, from a customer whose last order is 26 days old (at-risk cadence) — distance in time must not lose the basket

cases.text: ponme lo de siempre porfa
cases.probes: «lo de siempre» — the most elliptical reference there is; resolves to this customer's standing basket and nobody else's

cases.text: 10 de panceta adobada y 6 de lomo adobado… el lomo ponme 8 mejor
cases.probes: the message argues with itself — the later clause overwrites the qty of a line stated earlier, and only that line

cases.text: lo de siempre pero dóblame los callos
cases.probes: standing basket + an operation ON it («dóblame» = ×2 of the usual 10 kg), not a new line

cases.text: 40 sobres de serrano y otros tantos de cular
cases.probes: «otros tantos» — a quantity carried across clauses by reference instead of restated

cases.text: mándame el secreto, que el finde tengo dos comuniones
cases.probes: no quantity stated at all — the line may be filled from the norm, but it may not be filled SILENTLY

cases.text: 8 kg de oreja para mañana
cases.probes: implicit date («mañana») + a genuine two-candidate near-duplicate («oreja» = fresca o cocida) — the date resolves, the product is asked

cases.text: mándame el chorizo fresco y el tocino
cases.probes: a PARTIAL order from a customer with a standing basket — what he did not ask for must not appear

cases.text: ponme 6 kilos de salchichón del 55… no, que sean 8
cases.probes: in-message correction of a quantity — the final number wins, one line not two

cases.text: lo de siempre pero hoy sin criollo
cases.probes: standing basket MINUS one line — a subtraction expressed against a reference

cases.text: 6 de oreja cocida, 40 manitas y 5 de morro… el morro déjalo, que me queda
cases.probes: multi-line burst where one line is cancelled after being stated — the cancelled line must be gone, the others untouched

cases.text: buenas, soy el nuevo del Bar Carrasco, ponme 6 bandejas de cocido y 4 de bacon en lonchas
cases.probes: an UNKNOWN number naming a venue we know — the order must still be taken correctly (who they are is the comercial's call, not a reason to lose the order)

cases.text: esto es para la barra: 8 bandejas de pavo
cases.probes: the customer names an internal destination («la barra»), not a different customer — it must not be read as a new identity

cases.text: soy del Lumbre, el pedido del jueves de siempre
cases.probes: self-identification by short name on a number we already know — same basket, no confusion (this case used to carry a name outside the invented set)

cases.text: 10 kilos de los callos esos ya limpios
cases.probes: a paraphrase that is NOT one of the loaded aliases — retrieval, not the alias fast-path, has to land it

cases.text: 8 packs de bacon en lonchas
cases.probes: code-switch: two loanwords («packs», «bacon») inside an es-ES message, against a Spanish catalogue that prints BACON AHUMADO LONCHEADO 500 G

cases.text: ¿me puedes mandar 5 kg de langostinos cocidos?
cases.probes: a deliberate GAP (catalogue.json `_gaps`) — nothing in the house matches. Must be UNKNOWN, must reach the comercial, must never become a multiple choice at the customer

cases.text: sí hola de Casa Bermejo ponme seis kilos de oreja cocida cuarenta manitas y ocho de callos gracias
cases.probes: transcribed voice note: no punctuation, numbers as words, three lines in one breath

cases.text: ponme diez kilos de panceta adobada… bueno no, que sean doce
cases.probes: spoken self-correction with the numbers as words — the second number is the order

cases.text: lo de siempre para el viernes pero súbeme el secreto a treinta kilos
cases.probes: standing order by voice with ONE line lifted — the rest of the basket comes back unchanged

cases.text: ponme 20 sartas
cases.probes: LAW §5.7a DIMENSIONLESS: the product is certain, the CALIBRE is not (SARTA 500 G vs SARTA 1 KG — a declared `_dimension_pairs` row). Exactly one question, to the customer, two options plus the escape

cases.text: mándame el lomo
cases.probes: LAW §5.7a stated as data: «lomo» ties across MORE than two rows (embuchado caña · embuchado loncheado · adobado · ibérico) — `_near_duplicates.two_candidate:false`. It cannot reduce to two candidates, so it is UNKNOWN, not ambiguous: the comercial gets it, the customer gets no three-way multiple choice, and nothing fills clean

cases.text: 40 sobres de serrano y unas anchoas del cantábrico
cases.probes: LAW: a gap INSIDE a real order. The line we sell fills normally; the one we do not sell must not quietly become a product, must not be asked about, and reaches the comercial

cases.text: ponme también el jamoncito, 3 kg
cases.probes: LAW §5.7 NEVER TWICE: this customer already answered «el jamoncito» once (the seeded resolved half wrote the sku_aliases row). The alias must hit, the line must fill, and nothing may be asked again — the friction is self-extinguishing or it is not a moat

cases.text: ponme el jamoncito para el jueves
cases.probes: LAW §5.7: what one customer taught us is HIS. The same words from a customer who never taught them must not resolve clean (jamón cocido · serrano · ibérico all live in this catalogue)

cases.text: ponme 6 de oreja, 4 de morcilla y un par de velas
cases.probes: LAW §5.7a THE BUDGET: three genuinely doubtful mentions in one message (oreja fresca/cocida · morcilla burgos/cebolla · vela picante/dulce/salchichón 40/55). Three doubts may not become three questions — one question, two options

cases.text: y ponme 12 kilos de morcilla de burgos
cases.probes: LAW count-vs-weight: MORCILLA BURGOS ARROZ 400 G is sold BY UNIT in packs of 12 and he ordered it in kilos. The alias resolves the product, so the unit is what is left in doubt — the order may not silently convert kilos into units
